name: Performance Grapher Neo
description: Built specifically for Stream Deck Neo. Give your Neo Infobar a live performance dashboard without using a normal key: CPU / GPU / RAM overview, a selected GPU or CPU sensor with optional trend, or rotating readings for supported hardware sensors. Reuses PackRat’s bounded local monitoring history; no cloud account or Game FPS capture. Windows 10+, Stream Deck 7.6+ and Stream Deck Neo required. Sensor availability varies by PC.
release_notes: Dedicated Neo-only Infobar dashboard: CPU, GPU and RAM at a glance.
Add Single Metric and Rotating Metrics modes with optional live 60-second history.
Simple persistent settings; no normal keys, extra game-capture session, or cloud services.
